from pathlib import Path
import re
p = Path('src/data/lyrics/jab-se-cha-d-r-chhni-he-zainab-ki.md')
_, front, body = p.read_text().split('---', 2)
roman = front.split('romanLyrics: |-\\n', 1)[1]
def blocks(s):
    return [b.splitlines() for b in s.strip().split('\\n\\n')]
source, roman = blocks(body), blocks(re.sub(r'"'^  '"', '', roman, flags=re.M))
assert len(source) == len(roman) == 6
for i, (s, r) in enumerate(zip(source, roman), 1):
    assert len(s) == len(r) and r[0] == str(i)
assert all(c.isascii() or c == 'ṅ' for block in roman for line in block for c in line)
print('Verified six aligned stanza blocks and Roman character set')
PY"
